record.name: Smartsheet
record.one_liner: Smartsheet provides a developer API supporting OAuth and SDKs for C#, Java, Node.js, and Python, alongside Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration.

auth.notes: The developer documentation mentions registering applications that request user authorization via an OAuth Walkthrough.

access.notes: The email address used to register for Developer Tools must belong to an existing licensed Smartsheet user on a Business plan or higher.

api_surface.notes: Offers API guides and reference materials alongside SDKs for C#, Java, Node.js, and Python.

mcp.notes: The site includes sections for 'AI & Smartsheet MCP Server' and 'Smartsheet MCP Server Tools'.

buildability.reasoning: Developer tools registration requires an existing licensed Smartsheet user on a Business plan or higher, introducing a paid plan requirement before obtaining credentials.

evidence.claim: Lists API guides, API reference, SDKs for C#, Java, Node.js, and Python, and an AI & Smartsheet MCP Server.
